summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a US Form 6-K on September 24, 2026 disclosing a share repurchase under Article 64 of Argentina's Capital Markets Law No. 26,831 and CNV rules. The Argentine electric utility bought 100,000 book-entry common shares (ARS 1 par, one vote) on BYMA at an average ARS 2,016.27 per share, totaling ARS 201,627,129, with settlement September 25, 2026. No NYSE purchases occurred. The same-day buys stayed under 25% of the prior 90-business-day average daily volume. Arbitrage focus: recurring buyback execution pace versus dilution and cash burn.
